name: Blue Future Technologiegebiet Bleicherode-Wolkramshausen / Silicon Hünstein data center proposal
notes: Planned technology area between Wolkramshausen/Nohra/Hünstein in the Bleicherode municipality was reported as a roughly 53 ha hyperscale-capable data center proposal; local reporting and public council materials indicate the council later stopped the data-center plan. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Dienstleistungszentrum Eisenberg county administration data center
developer: Landratsamt Saale-Holzland-Kreis; Ed. Züblin AG / STRABAG
notes: New county service center at Jenaer Straße 40, 07607 Eisenberg, is listed as a 2024-2027 construction project and includes the county Rechenzentrum among the consolidated offices/functions. Administrative/server room scale; no MW capacity published.

name: Landratsamt Saalfeld-Rudolstadt server-rack colocation outsourcing
developer: Landratsamt Saalfeld-Rudolstadt; awardee undisclosed for security reasons
notes: EU/TED award notice 383433-2026 covers rental/provision of one fully usable server rack in a data center plus technical infrastructure and internet connection, with optional second rack; contract value EUR 146,400 and service period from 2026-08-03 to 2031-08-02. Exact data-center site and winner withheld for security.

name: Kommunaler IT-Service (KitS) centralized county IT/data-center infrastructure
notes: KitS centralized the district's IT on Dell VxRail HCI and operates services for the Landratsamt, 54 schools, and public entities; separate 2021 school data-center cooperation with Wartburgkreis/Eisenach covers 123 school sites. Sources also show the district uses the Thüringer Rechenzentrum for KitS, so the physical hosting location may be external to the district.

name: Lauscha / Thüringer Verwaltungscloud virtual municipal data-center pilot
developer: City of Lauscha / Freistaat Thüringen municipal-cloud program
notes: Local reporting says Lauscha helped pilot the Thüringer Verwaltungscloud, later developed as a virtual municipal Rechenzentrum. This is a virtual/public-administration cloud project rather than a disclosed standalone physical data-center build in Sonneberg district.

name: Datenverarbeitungszentrum Suhl GmbH service data center
notes: Business directory lists Datenverarbeitungszentrum Suhl GmbH at Fröhliche-Mann-Str. 3b, 98528 Suhl, offering Service-Rechenzentrum, scan, printing/shipping, billing, and technical services. Capacity not published.

name: AOK Thüringen / Lotto Thüringen Rechenzentrum on Gothaer Straße
notes: Datacenter-Insider reported a 2018 smoke incident at the Suhl data center of AOK Thüringen and Lotto Thüringen on Gothaer Straße; operations reportedly continued. Older local reporting also notes Suhl had a state data-center outpost, but the state planned to replace it with two other state data centers.

name: KIDS (Kommunale Informations- und Datentechnik Sömmerda) central data center
notes: Kommune21 described KIDS as a countywide e-government and IT-infrastructure project whose benefits include moving municipalities into a new central Rechenzentrum and later linking with Schmalkalden-Meiningen and Greiz systems for a municipal Thüringen-Cloud. No MW capacity published.

name: Unstrut-Hainich-Kreis data center for offices and schools
notes: Thüringer Allgemeine reported a new Rechenzentrum for county offices and schools in Unstrut-Hainich-Kreis. Detailed capacity and implementation status were not available from accessible snippets; classified as planned public-sector data-center activity.
